tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search manufacturers' published product catalogues by description, e.g. 'stainless steel hex bolt' or 'PVC ball valve'. Returns products with their supplier, a summary, price when published, and links.

tools.name: search_suppliers
tools.description: Find manufacturers from their US customs import records — including the many with no online catalogue. Rank is driven by shipments filed under the HS codes given, then by how well their shipped products match the query.

tools.name: get_supplier
tools.description: One supplier's record by slug: country, industry, customs history (shipments, US buyers, HS codes), researched company profile with key customers, catalogue summary and certifications.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One product's full record: description, characteristics, standards, images; with an account also spec tables, MOQ and lead time.

tools.name: match_bom
tools.description: Suppliers for each line of a bill of materials (up to 25 lines): matching catalogue products and factories whose customs record fits. Requires a Mati Logistics API key; one unit per line.
